This file is produced from the two fixture files, the git revisions named here and a divergence analysis: the simulation of the old revision and the candidate each run the same two routes and their per-tick signatures (clock, main RNG state, rounds issued and in flight, player health, event count) are compared; the full frames of tick 1 are diffed leaf by leaf.

cause.summary: The golden committed at d3ac3b2 pins the per-tick gameplay bytes of the T38 simulation with the gate-rifleman places of that revision. Commit 4772b24 moved the twelve gate-rifleman places (and rewrote the explanatory note beside them) and did not regenerate the golden. Their x, y, z are part of every per-tick frame and of the nested checkpoint, and decide the origin, line of sight and aim of their shots.
cause.note: positions[k] = [x, z, facing in rad] of de_east_(k+2). The new places stay at x >= 1053, the T23 strip, so the distant silhouettes remain visible from the west bank; the facing values did not change.

rule: Same simulation source (sourceSha256 unchanged), same predecessor, same two routes, same digest scheme (sha256 per 512 ticks of the whole gameplay frame: state, nested checkpoint and events, presentation fields removed). What changes is every block hash of both routes, because the frames contain the moved places from tick 1, and the route lengths, because the mission then plays out differently from the first shot fired from a new place.
